title: Reducibility of native weighted graphs on Rydberg Arrays
summary: We investigate the classical reducibility of random unit-disk graph (UDG) instances of the maximum independent set (MIS) and maximum weighted independent set (MWIS) problems, which can be natively realised in Rydberg atom quantum processors. Using state-of-the-art kernelisation techniques, we systematically probe how far classical preprocessing can simplify such native optimisation problems of varying size and connectivity.
